subject: Private Offer: Innotech Labs — Net90 & revised rev-share request
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya@innotech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@innotech.com
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private Offer request — net90 + rev-share ask

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week. We ran the adoption/usage modeling with our finance team and can move forward, but we need a couple of non-standard items to close the contract this quarter: 1) net90 payment terms (our standard vendor cadence), and 2) an increase in marketplace rev-share to 18% for the first 12 months (we're targeting higher initial consumption). We also have a standard termination-for-convenience clause in our SOW that we'd like honored.

Attached is the SOW and a simple private-offer worksheet with expected volumes. Can you confirm if Redwood can accommodate net90 and the rev-share increase for this private offer on AWS? If not, what tradeoffs (e.g., larger upfront credit, shorter rev-share uplift window) would help bridge to an approveable deal?

Ideal close: 9/10/2027.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call.

Priya Shah
VP, Strategic Partnerships
Innotech Labs

Subject: Fwd: Private Offer request — net90 + rev-share ask

Forwarding Innotech's ask — short summary below.

What they want: net90 payment terms + marketplace rev-share at 18% for months 0-12; termination-for-convenience in their SOW.

Why this matters: Innotech is a mid-market SaaS buyer with pilot-to-production traction; expected ARR on Redwood hosted inference is ~$650k ARR year 1 per their forecast. AWS listing is preferred by their procurement. Standard Redwood marketplace rev-share is 15% and standard payment is net30. 

Trade-offs I'm willing to consider to get approval quickly: a) a 60-day upfront credit (one-time) to reduce cash exposure, b) cap the elevated rev-share to the first 6 months instead of 12, or c) require a 6-month usage commit.

Request: Karthik — need Deal Desk assessment and exec sign-off guidance. Lauren — please flag any legal risk with their termination language. Mina — please advise finance / cash exposure if we do net90 and possible upfront credit.

Attachments: Innotech_PrivateOffer_Request.xlsx (volume sheet).

Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
[attachment: Innotech_PrivateOffer_Request.xlsx]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 13:23:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: Private Offer request — net90 + rev-share ask

Marissa — thanks for the heads up and the volume sheet. Quick deal desk read:

- Rev-share: baseline 15%. Increasing to 18% for 12 months is material and would impact marketplace revenue split; approval requires Exec sign-off. If we limit the uplift to 6 months, we can likely approve at VP Finance level.
- Net90: non-standard from a cash/credit risk perspective. Net90 for a new customer with projected ARR of $650k is a finance exposure we need to quantify. Mina, can you run the cash impact if we accept net90 vs net30 and if we offer a 60-day upfront credit (one-time)?
- Termination language: Lauren, any contractual redlines we cannot accept if they keep unilateral termination-for-convenience? We typically push for mutuality or notice periods for SOWs tied to private offers.

Suggested approach to get to an answer fast: request a 60-day upfront credit + limit rev-share uplift to months 1–6. If they insist on 12 months, escalate to Markus for exec approval and include a proposed offset (e.g., 30% higher usage commit to qualify).

I will prepare a short exec memo with the financial delta and recommended offsets for Markus to review.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Head of Deal Desk, Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 09:38:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: Private Offer request — net90 + rev-share ask

Folks — ran a quick sensitivity: assuming $650k ARR and invoicing cadence per their volumes, net90 increases DSO by ~60 days compared to net30. Cash exposure over first 12 months is ~$120k (present value loss + working capital). If we provide a 60-day upfront credit equal to one month's expected spend (~$18k), exposure drops to ~$45k.

Accepting net90 without an upfront credit is higher risk; if Legal can add stronger termination notice/recoup language, risk can be partially mitigated. From finance POV, the priority is either an upfront credit sized to mitigate first-quarter cash gap or a shorter rev-share uplift window.

I'll include the numbers in the exec memo.

Mina Haddad
Sr. Finance Manager, Revenue & Marketplace | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya@innotech.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 17:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Exec approval request — Innotech Labs private offer (Net90 + rev-share uplift)

Markus — looping you in for quick exec sign-off (deal details below). We need a decision to meet their internal buying timeline (target close 9/10).

Summary:
- Customer: Innotech Labs (Strategic pilot -> production).
- ARR estimate year 1: ~$650k.
- Ask: Net90 payment terms; marketplace rev-share 18% for months 0–12; termination-for-convenience in SOW.
- Proposed Redwood offsets: 60-day one-time upfront credit (~$18k), limit rev-share uplift to months 1–6 (vs 12) if possible, require 6-month minimum usage commit, and legal to add 30-days cure notice for termination.
- Financial impact: Mina's memo attached — incremental cash exposure ~45–120k depending on offsets.
- Contracting: Lauren flagged termination language; she recommends mutual termination or additional notice/recoup language.

Request: Exec approval to accept Net90 with the proposed offsets (60-day credit + rev-share limited to 6 months) or explicit approval to accept a 12-month uplift and Net90 with the stated financial exposure.

If approved, Karthik will issue a private offer listing for AWS and we will route the DocuSign. Suggested approver: you or CRO if you prefer.

Thanks — happy to discuss live.

Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
